verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway explicitly documents that everything configurable via its management Web UI (Kong Manager) can also be done via the RESTful Admin API or declarative config through decK (kong-gh-10, kong-gh-11, kong-gh-5), and Insomnia's Inso CLI mirrors many UI actions like import, lint, test, and export (kong-docs-13, kong-docs-14, kong-docs-31, kong-docs-42). This gives strong first-party evidence of API/UI parity across the core gateway and testing tools. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of full parity (e.g., no evidence every Insomnia AI feature like mock-generation or commit-message suggestions has a CLI equivalent), and a public OpenAPI spec for the Admin API was not found at expected paths (kong-probe-2).
